title: Biomarkers with Oral NMN Intake Leads to Better Anti-aging Effects
abstract:
The “NAD world” has become more popular thanks to the many findings and new research available. One of the most known [NAD precursors](https://cimasci.com/products/nicotinamide-mononucleotide/), called NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide), boosts NAD levels in the body effectively compared to the other precursors. Therefore, NMN it’s the most studied NAD supplement when it comes to the benefits of NAD. The recent finding focuses on oral NMN intake and the impact on changes in biomarkers.
## The main points  
All these measurements after eight weeks prove that NMN can improve the skin (skin moisturizing, fine lines, dark spots, freckles, whitening the skin, etc.), the sleep (easier falling asleep, better waking up, better sleep quality), and improve physical activity and fatigue (better mobility, less fatigue, better recovery after exercising, etc.).  
Other improvements were observed, such as less eye strain, less weight gain, better night vision, enhanced constipation, better mood, faster hair growth, less joint pain, better thinking, and more.  
Among the other findings done in humans, there were other NAD+ precursors used to boost NAD+ levels. Clinical studies in humans were done by taking NR (Nicotinamide riboside). **NR** is another NAD precursor converted to NAD via NMN first. However, the results showed no improvements in the parameters and no anti-aging effect. NR didn’t show any positive anti-aging effects. This can be due to NR’s slow and reduced absorption, which weakened the effects.
## Conclusion  
With the latest study in mind, nowadays, NMN can help in practical medicine to improve biomarkers including lipid metabolism, glucose metabolism, immunity, hormone disbalances, and blood parameters in biochemistry used as clinical tests. The positive changes of certain biomarkers suggest that NMN can be effectively and safely used as a supplement for prolonging lifespan and improving anti-aging effects.
